characters.prompt_summary: A hardened and stoic Three Kingdoms era general. He has a weathered, frostbitten face with intense, unyielding eyes. He is wearing battered iron armor that shows the heavy wear of years of campaigning. His overall design fits an animated historical epic style.

A younger Three Kingdoms era junior officer with a deeply exhausted face. He is wearing standard-issue junior officer armor that is heavily worn, layered with thick winter wraps. His overall appearance is weary and desperate in an animated historical epic style.

locations.prompt_summary: A treacherous mountain gorge in the Three Kingdoms era. Jagged cliffs of dark stone rise sharply on all sides. The environment is blanketed in deep snow, featuring sheer vertical drops and blinding blizzards.

A war-torn valley below the mountain snowline. Smoldering wooden siege engines and scattered military tents dot the muddy landscape. Heavy mountain fog is actively lifting to reveal the expansive, chaotic battlefield.

props.prompt_summary: A heavy iron ring-pommel sword from the Three Kingdoms era. The blade is dull, scratched, and battle-worn, housed in a matching, heavily used scabbard.
A large, heavy felt blanket. The material features a rough, thick historical texture designed for extreme cold insulation. It is coarse and darkly colored.

characters.prompt_summary: General Zhao standing in a blinding daytime blizzard. His battered iron armor is dusted with accumulated snow. He maintains a stoic, unflinching facial expression against the harsh freezing wind.

Lieutenant Wei struggling in a severe winter blizzard under dull daytime light. His worn armor and winter wraps are covered in snow. He has a profoundly exhausted appearance, shivering and squinting against the storm.

locations.prompt_summary: The treacherous mountain gorge under a harsh daytime blizzard. Blinding snow and freezing winds obscure the jagged dark stone cliffs, severely reducing visibility. Snowdrifts pile heavily along the deadly incline.

props.prompt_summary: The iron sword is held in the freezing air. Small flakes of snow cling to the cold, battle-worn metal blade under the dull daytime winter light.
